title: April Fools' Problem (medium)
statementMd:
The marmots need to prepare $*k*$ problems for HC$^{2}$ over $*n*$ days. Each problem, once prepared, also has to be printed.

The preparation of a problem on day $*i*$ (at most one per day) costs $*a*_{*i*}$ CHF, and the printing of a problem on day $*i*$ (also at most one per day) costs $*b*_{*i*}$ CHF. Of course, a problem cannot be printed before it has been prepared (but doing both on the same day is fine).

What is the minimum cost of preparation and printing?

## Input

The first line of input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 2200$). The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5bbc0132dffe069c35885e7e95b4656b61a98138.png)) — the preparation costs. The third line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c014bbf64e9165f1232d9154fad412ab5acc75d0.png)) — the printing costs.

## Output

Output the minimum cost of preparation and printing $*k*$ problems — that is, the minimum possible sum $*a*_{*i*_{1}} + *a*_{*i*_{2}} + ... + *a*_{*i*_{*k*}} + *b*_{*j*_{1}} + *b*_{*j*_{2}} + ... + *b*_{*j*_{*k*}}$, where $1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *j*_{1} < *j*_{2} < ... < *j*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$ and $*i*_{1} ≤ *j*_{1}$, $*i*_{2} ≤ *j*_{2}$, ..., $*i*_{*k*} ≤ *j*_{*k*}$.

## Note

In the sample testcase, one optimum solution is to prepare the first problem on day $1$ and print it on day $1$, prepare the second problem on day $2$ and print it on day $4$, prepare the third problem on day $3$ and print it on day $5$, and prepare the fourth problem on day $6$ and print it on day $8$.
statementZhMd:
土拨鼠需要在 $*n*$ 天内为 HC$^{2}$ 准备 $*k*$ 道题目。每道题目准备完成后，还必须将其印刷出来。

在第 $*i*$ 天准备一道题目（每天最多准备一道）的费用为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 瑞士法郎；在第 $*i*$ 天印刷一道题目（每天最多印刷一道）的费用为 $*b*_{*i*}$ 瑞士法郎。当然，题目不能在准备完成之前印刷（但在同一天完成准备和印刷是允许的）。

准备并印刷题目的最小费用是多少？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 2200$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5bbc0132dffe069c35885e7e95b4656b61a98138.png)），表示准备费用。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c014bbf64e9165f1232d9154fad412ab5acc75d0.png)，表示印刷费用。

## 输出格式

输出准备并印刷 $*k*$ 道题目的最小费用，即满足以下条件时，$*a*_{*i*_{1}} + *a*_{*i*_{2}} + ... + *a*_{*i*_{*k*}} + *b*_{*j*_{1}} + *b*_{*j*_{2}} + ... + *b*_{*j*_{*k*}}$ 的可能最小值：$1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *j*_{1} < *j*_{2} < ... < *j*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$，并且 $*i*_{1} ≤ *j*_{1}$、$*i*_{2} ≤ *j*_{2}$、...、$*i*_{*k*} ≤ *j*_{*k*}$。

## 说明

在样例测试中，一种最优方案是在第 $1$ 天准备第一道题目并将其印刷，在第 $2$ 天准备第二道题目并在第 $4$ 天将其印刷，在第 $3$ 天准备第三道题目并在第 $5$ 天将其印刷，以及在第 $6$ 天准备第四道题目并在第 $8$ 天将其印刷。
